newsitem.title: USA: Cisco Systems to double size of N.C. facility.
newsitem.headline: Cisco Systems to double size of N.C. facility.

text.p: Cisco Systems Inc said Thursday it plans to double the size of its operation at Research Triangle Park, bringing the number of employees there up to 2,000 within several years.

The company said it exercised its option to purchase an additional 55 acres of land adjacent to their campus at the site, bringing total acreage at the company's east coast headquarters to about 100 acres.

"At the time of the ground breaking in August 1994, we saw ourselves hiring 1,000 people in this area," Nick Francis, director of marketing for Cisco's Interworks Business Unit, told Reuters. "Our business is just going very well and we've had good recruiting on the east coast."

A statement from Cisco said the purchase of the additional parcel of land will allow the company to add as many as three buildings to its current three (including one under construction), given the expected continued growth of its internetworking solutions business.

The company said the additions will give Cisco nearly 600,000 square feet under roof and the facilities needed to increase their work force in the area to nearly 2,000 people, It moved into the first building on the site less than 19 months ago.
The company, which currently employees about 550 people at Research Triangle Park, did not give the price of the land or the construction project.
Francis said the project will not require the company to go into debt.
Francis declined to put a definite time frame on the goal of having 2,000 employees. "If business goes well, we think it will be within a couple years," he said.
